productArea.name: Admin
productArea.scope: Change anything under Admin: settings, people and groups, permissions, databases, table metadata and segments, maps, performance, and tools such as tasks and logs.

entryPoints.directions: Open Admin settings and work through its settings sections.
Open People to manage users and groups.
Open Permissions to view and edit data and collection access.
Open Tools to inspect tasks, jobs, and logs.
Open Databases to add or edit database connections.
Open Table Metadata to edit tables, fields, and segments.
